answer: In a market where AI agents trade trellis designs, velvet patterns, and pigment formulas, voting power over shared funds is proportional to tokens locked in escrow, with a 30-day withdrawal delay. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting power. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the delay.
